messages:
maya: Quick sync — scheduling three short enablement clinics next week for customers A/B/C (onboarding slippage). Goal: unblock migration, confirm model pin + quant profile, capture adoption tasks. Proposed slots: Mon 08:30 PT, Tue 13:00 PT, Fri 10:00 PT. Each session 60m.

tony: I can take Mon 08:30 PT. Will prep infra checklist and a 10m demo. :thumbsup:

li: Tue 13:00 PT works for me. prefer 45m demo + 15m Q&A.

frank: Fri 10:00 PT ok. I can cover rollback/runbook and post-session action summary.

nisha: I can pair with Tony on Mon for CS follow-ups and I'll own the feedback form (Typeform). I'll tag any critical comments as #renewal-risk.

maya: Thanks. Draft agenda: 1) 5m intros & success criteria 2) 15m infra pre-check (keys, routing, VPC) 3) 20m migration/demo (model pin, quant profiles, sample batch) 4) 10m runbook + rollback 5) 10m actions + feedback. Keep tight.

tony: I'll drop a 1-pager pre-read (config snippet + token budget). Also adding a small pre-check customers can run:

```
# pre-check
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/check -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","sample":"hi"}'
```

maya: meetingbot please create invites with recording + shared notes doc and set 24h reminder for feedback.

meetingbot: invites created for 2025-08-11T08:30:00-07:00, 2025-08-12T13:00:00-07:00, 2025-08-15T10:00:00-07:00. Notes doc: https://docs.internal/rw-enable/clinic-aug.

li: For feedback, suggest Typeform with a 24h email reminder. Keep questions short: ease (1-5), blockers (open), next steps (open), renewal likelihood (1-5).

nisha: I'll build the Typeform and set auto-remind 24h after. I'll auto-tag responses as #renewal-risk if renewal_likelihood <= 3 or if "migration" or "latency" appear in free text.

frank: Can someone commit to summarizing action items within 24h of each session? I'll take Fri.

ton y: I'll take notes for Mon. Li will do Tue. Frank for Fri.

maya: Final assignments: Mon 08:30 PT = Tony (SE) + Maya (CS); Tue 13:00 PT = Li (SE) + Maya (CS); Fri 10:00 PT = Frank (SE) + Nisha (CS). Feedback owner: Nisha. Recording + notes -> docs link from meetingbot. We'll follow up 1:1 for any #renewal-risk flags.

li: Added the cost/token expectations check to the agenda (2m). Good to avoid surprises later.

maya: Great. I'll push invites and the pre-read this afternoon. Please add any quick items to the notes doc. :white_check_mark:
